draft_text: Cultivated meat is meat produced using cell‑culture technology. It contains some or all of the critical cell types found in conventional meat and is intended to replicate the sensory and nutritional profile of traditionally produced meat, seafood, or organ meat.

claims.claim_text: Cultivated meat is meat produced using cell‑culture technology that comprises some or all of the critical cell types of meat and aims to replicate the sensory and nutritional profile of conventional meat, seafood, or organ meat.
